title: Saya no Uta: The Song of Saya — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
Saya no Uta: The Song of Saya did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Saya no Uta, also known as The Song of Saya, is a 2003 investigative horror eroge developed by Nitroplus, with lolicon and Lovecraftian horror elements. It was first released for Windows only in Japan in December 2003, and was later ported to other platforms.

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Saya no Uta: The Song of Saya shows exactly where that breaks. Former professor at the university hospital who disappeared after an incident at the hospital. Both Saya (who calls him "Father") and Ryoko have tried to find him in the past, to no avail.
